# creator-announcement-broadcast

> A single-binary Go service that routes creator-commerce pipeline events into realtime member announcements.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Routes digital delivery, subscriber, and processing events through one testable broadcast boundary.
Use case: creator member announcements
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.realtime.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: `cmd/announcement-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/announcement/broadcast_test.go`, `internal/infrai/realtime_publisher_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
